basic_details.job_title: Jamia Hamdard Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 14 Field Workers, Project Research Scientist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Jamia Hamdard, New Delhi has invited applications for 14 temporary posts under the ICMR-funded research project "Scale up of competency Driven Program Management for Strengthening NTEP – An Implementation Research to catalyze performance of selected districts of five states", under Principal Investigator Dr. N Ravichandran. Pay is Rs. 26,000 to Rs. 72,800 per month, consolidated, with no HRA. Send your Resume/CV to [email protected] up to 25 November 2026, 05:00 p.m.; interviews are on 26 and 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare your Resume/CV for the post you want.
Send it by email to [email protected] up to 25 November 2026, 05:00 p.m.
Attach the supporting documents asked for; incomplete applications and applications without them are summarily rejected.
If you are applying for more than one post, apply separately for each post.
Wait to be called: only shortlisted candidates are called for personal discussion/interview.
The notice does not give an email subject line or a CV format.
important_instructions: Candidates must produce all certificates in original for verification at the time of joining; those who fail to bring them will not be allowed to join the selected post. Incorrect or false information during the interview/personal discussion process disqualifies the candidature at any stage. Project location is the selected intervention districts in West Bengal, Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Tamil Nadu; candidates are expected to reside in the selected districts, and no relocation allowance or amount is paid. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview/personal discussion. Candidates have no right to claim permanent employment under ICMR or continuation in any other project or position of Jamia Hamdard. The Principal Investigator may accept or reject any application without assigning a reason, and no correspondence or recommendation is entertained. Canvassing or outside influence for shortlisting and employment is treated as disqualification and the candidate is debarred from the selection process. Any addendum or corrigendum will be issued on the website only (www.jamiahamdard.edu), not in the press.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The posts are under a research project run from Jamia Hamdard, Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi, and funded by ICMR. The notice says the project involves fieldwork for data collection, training and capacity building for TB healthcare functionaries, so travel outside Delhi and within India and the selected intervention districts is required.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 14 posts in total (1 + 5 + 1 + 1 + 6). Each post is marked (UR); no other category break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints no age limit. It says candidates "fulfilling the required qualifications, experience, and age criteria" may send their CV. Qualification and experience must be in a relevant discipline/field and from a reputed institution/organization recognized by the relevant authority. Experience counts from the date of completion of the minimum educational qualification. Essential: Post Graduate in any discipline with 5-6 years' experience project management, or MBBS/MPH/MHA/PGDHM/MBA (Health Management)/MPS/MS (Epidemiology)/MD (Preventive and Social Medicine) with 3 to 4 years of experience in public health programme management level or research experiences, or PhD (in public/community Health areas). Desirable: Experience in working in TB elimination program at field level or at program management level for 3 years; strongly demonstrated report writing skills. Essential: Post Graduate in any discipline with 3-5 years' experience in community mobilization and education, or MPH/MHA/PGDHM/MBA (Health Management)/MPS/MS (Epidemiology)/MSW/MA (HR), with 1-2 years of experience in public health. Desirable: Experience of working in TB elimination program at the field level or program management level; experience or exposure to HRH issues. Essential: Post Graduate in any discipline with 3-5 years' experience in community mobilization and educational campaign, or MPH/MHA/PGDHM/MBA (Health Management)/MPS/MS (Epidemiology)/MSW/MA (HR), with 1-2 years of experience in public health. Desirable: Experience of working in TB elimination program at the field level or program management level; experience or exposure to HRH issues. Essential: Undergraduate in any subjects with minimum of one year experience in Community Mobilization/educational campaign experiences. Desirable: Experience of data collection and data management. Essential: Undergraduate in any subjects with minimum of 6 months experience in data collection/survey experiences. Desirable: Experience of data collection and data management. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The first four posts are offered for 36 months; the notice prints no period for Field Workers (PTS-II). All posts are contractual, purely temporary and project-based, and the engagement is co-terminus with the project, subject to sanction of the grant and date. Engagement is subject to periodical performance, and unsatisfactory performance can result in termination after 15 days of notice. No provident fund, HRA, Leave Travel Concession, Medical Claim or similar benefits are admissible.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Jamia Hamdard Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your Resume/CV for the post you want. Send it by email to [email protected] up to 25 November 2026, 05:00 p.m. Attach the supporting documents asked for; incomplete applications and applications without them are summarily rejected. If you are applying for more than one post, apply separately for each post. Wait to be called: only shortlisted candidates are called for personal discussion/interview. The notice does not give an email subject line or a CV format.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates are called for personal discussion/interview at Jamia Hamdard, Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi-110062. Document verification and the interview take place on the same day, from 9.30 am onwards. Candidates reporting after the scheduled date/time are not allowed to appear. Meeting the essential qualification and experience does not guarantee selection, and the decision of the selection committee is final. All original certificates, including educational qualification Proof of date of birth Experience certificates/testimonials One self-attested recent passport size photograph ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID/Driving License etc.) One set of self-attested photocopies of all documents

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Jamia Hamdard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 posts: 1 Project Research Scientist (Medical), 5 Project Technical Support / Project Associate, 1 Senior Project Assistant (PTS-III), 1 Project Technical Support-II / Field Supervisor and 6 Field Workers (PTS-II), all marked UR.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The Resume/CV must be emailed up to 25 November 2026, 05:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for the Jamia Hamdard project posts?
faq.answer: Send your Resume/CV by email to [email protected] with the supporting documents asked for. For more than one post, apply separately for each post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Field Worker (PTS-II)?
faq.answer: Undergraduate in any subjects with a minimum of 6 months experience in data collection/survey experiences. Experience of data collection and data management is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the Field Supervisor post?
faq.answer: Undergraduate in any subjects with a minimum of one year experience in Community Mobilization/educational campaign experiences.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for each post?
faq.answer: Project Research Scientist (Medical) gets Rs.72800/- p.m.; Project Technical Support / Project Associate and Senior Project Assistant (PTS-III) get Rs. 36,400/- p.m.; Field Supervisor and Field Workers get Rs.26000. No HRA or provident fund is admissible.

faq.question: Q7. When are the interviews held?
faq.answer: Interviews with document verification are on 26 November 2026 for Project Technical Support/Project Associate and Senior Project Assistant, and on 27 November 2026 for the other three posts, from 9.30 am onwards at Jamia Hamdard, Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi-110062.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. All posts are purely temporary, contractual and project-based, co-terminus with the project, and carry no right to permanent employment under ICMR or continuation in any other project or position of Jamia Hamdard.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview/personal discussion.
